derived_lemmas.statement: Theta'(u)/Theta(u)=sum_n lambda_n/(1+lambda_n u) and near zero equals sum_k (-1)^k m_k u^k
all m_k are real because the zero set is conjugation invariant
any positive Stieltjes representing measure for m_k is supported in [0,Lambda] because 0<=m_k<=S Lambda^k
the compact-support Stieltjes transform agreeing with Theta'/Theta near zero excludes every logarithmic-derivative pole outside the negative real slit

directions.route: RH -> u_n<0 -> lambda_n>0 -> mu=sum lambda_n delta_lambda_n -> Stieltjes moments -> H0,H1 PSD
H0,H1 PSD all orders -> positive Stieltjes measure -> compact support -> Stieltjes transform analytic off negative slit -> no nonnegative/nonreal poles of Theta'/Theta -> zeros Theta negative -> RH

corollaries.statement: RH false implies there exists finite N for which H0_N or H1_N is not PSD
